useCase: Identifying GAN-generated images and attributing them to specific AI model architectures. Critical for ディープフェイク検出 and content provenance.
mechanism:
The 検出 process:

1. **Spectral 特徴 extraction**: Computes the 2D FFT power スペクトル and extracts azimuthally-averaged frequency profiles unique to each GAN architecture.

2. **Architecture-specific パターン**: Different GAN architectures (StyleGAN, ProGAN, BigGAN, CycleGAN) produce distinct spectral fingerprints due to their specific upsampling and normalization layers.

3. **Fingerprint classification**: A multi-class SVM classifier trained on spectral 特徴 識別する both the presence of GAN アーティファクト and the specific architecture.

4. **Cross-model validation**: Results are cross-validated against a database of known GAN spectral signatures.
accuracy: Very 高 - 92-98% for known GAN architectures. Accuracy decreases for novel or fine-tuned architectures.
name: GANフィンガープリント検出
algorithm: GANアーキテクチャ指紋分類器
parameters:
FFT: 256x256 power スペクトル
特徴抽出: azimuthal averaging + radial profiles
Classifier: Multi-class SVM with RBF kernel
Known architectures: StyleGAN1/2/3, ProGAN, BigGAN, CycleGAN, StarGAN, DCGAN
description: 識別します unique spectral fingerprints left by Generative Adversarial Networks. Each GAN architecture produces characteristic frequency-domain パターン in generated images that serve as reliable フォレンジック identifiers.

references.title: Marra, F. et al. (2019). Do GANs Leave Artificial Fingerprints? IEEE MIPR.
Yu, N. et al. (2019). Attributing Fake Images to GANs: Learning and Analyzing GAN Fingerprints. ICCV.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Gragnaniello, D. et al. (2021). Are GAN Generated Images Easy to Detect? IEEE MMSP.

strengths:
• Extremely high 精度 for known GAN families
• Can attribute images to specific GAN architectures
• Robust against common image transformations
• Works without requiring the original model
limitations:
• 新しい/未知のGANアーキテクチャには効果が低い
• ファインチューニングされたモデルはフィンガープリントを変更する可能性
• 拡散モデルはフィンガープリント特性が異なる
• 重い後処理でフィンガープリントが劣化する可能性
